lead_summary.zh: 烏軍千架無人機襲俄；台股重挫2,635點
lead_summary.en: Record drone barrage on Russia; TAIEX plunges 2,635

title.zh: 烏軍1,336架無人機襲俄　刻赤大橋遭擊中
title.en: Ukraine fires record 1,336 drones at Russia; Crimea bridge hit

body.zh: 俄羅斯國防部資料顯示，防空部隊 16 日凌晨在 16 個地區擊落 1,336 架烏克蘭無人機，超過 10 月 29 日的 1,254 架，為 2022 年全面開戰以來規模最大的一夜空襲；莫斯科市長索比亞寧說，自 15 日晚間約有 600 架飛向莫斯科地區，其中 191 架被擊落。克里米亞親俄行政首長阿克肖諾夫表示，連接克里米亞與俄國本土的刻赤大橋遭擊中，公路交通一度暫停、鐵路照常，克宮發言人佩斯科夫稱損害輕微。烏克蘭總統澤倫斯基 15 日晚間表示，對煉油廠的打擊已使俄國過半煉油產能停擺，路透無法獨立證實，兩名業界人士則估計產能減少約 30%。
body.en: Russian defence ministry data showed air defences downed 1,336 Ukrainian drones over 16 regions overnight into the 16th, topping the 1,254 recorded on October 29 and making it the largest one-night attack since the full-scale war began in 2022; Moscow Mayor Sergei Sobyanin said about 600 drones had headed for the Moscow region since Sunday evening, with 191 brought down. Crimea's Russian-installed head Sergei Aksyonov said the Kerch Strait bridge linking the peninsula to Russia was struck, temporarily halting road traffic while rail kept running, and Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov called the damage minor. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said on Sunday night that refinery strikes had knocked out more than half of Russia's refining capacity, which Reuters could not verify; two industry sources put the reduction at about 30%.

title.zh: 荷莫茲海峽再有油輪遇襲　伊朗稱航道布雷
title.en: Another tanker hit in Hormuz; Iran says route is mined

body.zh: 英國海事貿易行動辦公室（UKMTO）表示，16 日一艘駛離荷莫茲海峽的油輪遭不明飛行物擊中、機艙起火，船員均安，並將事件列為攻擊、調查中。伊朗革命衛隊海軍稱，兩艘依美方指引航行的油輪在海峽南段觸雷，並宣稱自 15 日以來已有 6 艘油輪起火下沉，警告航商勿與美軍合作；伊朗陸軍海軍另稱海峽以東一艘油輪觸雷受困，路透無法獨立證實上述說法。國際能源總署（IEA）指出，10 月波斯灣（不含阿曼）石油出口為每日 1,840 萬桶，約比戰前低 26%。
body.en: The UK Maritime Trade Operations agency said a tanker leaving the Strait of Hormuz on the 16th was hit by an unidentified projectile that started an engine-room fire; all crew were safe and it classified the incident as an attack under investigation. Iran's Revolutionary Guards navy said two tankers following US directions struck mines in the southern strait, claimed six tankers had caught fire and were sinking since Sunday, and warned shippers not to cooperate with the US military; Iran's regular navy separately said a tanker east of the strait hit a mine, and Reuters could not independently confirm the claims. The International Energy Agency said Gulf oil exports excluding Oman were 18.4 million barrels a day in October, about 26% below pre-war levels.

title.zh: 川習普週四深圳會面　美方稱談核武削減
title.en: Trump to meet Xi, Putin Thursday; US says focus is nuclear cuts

body.zh: 白宮發言人表示，川普將於 19 日（週四）在深圳亞太經合會（APEC）場邊與中國國家主席習近平、俄羅斯總統普丁會面，討論「減少全球核武」；一名資深官員說預料不會簽署正式協議，伊朗戰爭可能被提及，烏克蘭則不在議程內。中國外交部發言人毛寧形容這場會談具「開創性」，有助大國關係穩定，但未說明習近平是否回應核武議題；克宮 16 日表示預期會談將產生重大全球影響，但未公布議程。
body.en: A White House spokeswoman said Trump will meet Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin on Thursday, November 19, on the sidelines of the APEC summit in Shenzhen to discuss reducing nuclear weapons worldwide; a senior official said no formal agreement is expected, that the Iran war will likely come up, and that Ukraine will not. Chinese Foreign Ministry spokesperson Mao Ning called the talks groundbreaking and a way to keep major-power ties stable but did not say whether Xi would take up the nuclear push; the Kremlin said on the 16th it expects a major global impact but announced no agenda.

title.zh: 愛沙尼亞12月起封對俄邊境　指俄策畫破壞
title.en: Estonia to shut Russia border Dec 1 over alleged sabotage plot

body.zh: 愛沙尼亞總理米哈爾表示，俄羅斯軍事情報總局（GRU）下令於 14 日晚間破壞無人機製造商 Threod Systems，行動在塔林北方的維姆西被阻止，檢察總長阿西說已逮捕 8 名住在拉脫維亞的嫌犯。外交部長察赫納以掌握 GRU 涉入的「明確證據」為由，宣布自 12 月 1 日起關閉全部 3 個對俄口岸。俄國外交部發言人札哈羅娃對塔斯社表示將查證此事，若屬實將視為又一次「恐俄」行為。
body.en: Estonian Prime Minister Kristen Michal said Russia's GRU military intelligence ordered a sabotage attempt on drone maker Threod Systems on the night of the 14th, which was foiled in Viimsi north of Tallinn, and chief prosecutor Astrid Asi said eight suspects living in Latvia were arrested. Foreign Minister Margus Tsahkna, citing clear evidence of GRU involvement, announced that all three border crossings with Russia will close from December 1. Russian Foreign Ministry spokeswoman Maria Zakharova told TASS that Moscow would check the plans and would regard them, if real, as further Russophobia.

title.zh: 火神火箭發射失敗　亞馬遜40顆衛星損失
title.en: Vulcan rocket fails, losing 40 Amazon Leo satellites

body.zh: 聯合發射聯盟（ULA）的火神（Vulcan）火箭 15 日自佛州卡納維爾角升空，約 10 分鐘後發生異常，未能將 40 顆亞馬遜 Leo 寬頻衛星送入軌道，為 ULA 自 2006 年成立以來首次任務完全失敗。肇因仍待調查，ULA 表示將盡快恢復飛行；這是火神火箭第 5 次發射，亞馬遜共預訂 38 次火神發射，並將等候調查結果再使用該型火箭，其 Leo 星系完整建置需逾 3,300 顆衛星。
body.en: United Launch Alliance's Vulcan rocket lifted off from Cape Canaveral, Florida, on the 15th but suffered an anomaly about 10 minutes into flight and failed to put 40 Amazon Leo broadband satellites into orbit, ULA's first outright mission failure since it was formed in 2006. The cause is under investigation and ULA said it would return to flight as quickly as possible; it was only Vulcan's fifth flight, and Amazon, which has 38 Vulcan launches booked, will wait for the findings before flying on it again, with more than 3,300 satellites needed for the full Leo constellation.

title.zh: 美堵海外資料中心漏洞　限中企用AI晶片
title.en: US curbs Chinese access to AI chips via overseas data centers

body.zh: 美國商務部工業與安全局（BIS）16 日發布暫行最終規則，位於印尼、馬來西亞、新加坡、泰國與巴西的資料中心，若讓總部設在中國、澳門等武器禁運國家的企業使用超過 1,200 萬 TPP 的算力，輸往該處的先進 AI 晶片須申請出口許可。BIS 表示目的在防止既有管制遭「規避」；規則自刊登聯邦公報起生效，已在服務相關客戶的資料中心有 90 天時間取得許可。被懷疑向中國企業出租美國 AI 晶片算力的新加坡業者 Megaspeed 則表示業務合法，並已委任外部律師進行內部調查。
body.en: The Commerce Department's Bureau of Industry and Security issued an interim final rule on the 16th requiring export licences for advanced AI chips sent to data centers in Indonesia, Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Brazil that give companies headquartered in China, Macau or other arms-embargoed countries access to more than 12 million TPP of computing power. BIS said the aim is to stop existing controls from being circumvented; the rule takes effect on Federal Register publication, and data centers already serving such customers get 90 days to obtain a licence. Singapore's Megaspeed, suspected of renting US AI chip capacity to Chinese firms, said it conducts lawful business and has hired outside counsel for an internal investigation.

title.zh: 輝達財報登場在即　董事會不考慮黃仁勳回任
title.en: Nvidia reports soon; board not weighing Huang's return

body.zh: 據 CNBC 報導，輝達董事會目前不考慮讓 11 月 12 日宣布辭任的黃仁勳回任執行長，重心放在國安相關調查；川普 16 日則表示黃仁勳回鍋「並非壞主意」。美國財政部長貝森特 15 日受訪時主張董事會應向外延攬新領導人，並要求董事會與外部律師在 10 天內答覆出口合規問題。輝達將於美國時間 17 日盤後公布財報，由財務長兼代理執行長克瑞斯說明，公司先前預估營收約 1,080 億美元（上下 2%），且不含中國資料中心運算營收。
body.en: CNBC reported that Nvidia's board is not considering bringing back Jensen Huang, whose resignation as CEO was announced on November 12, and is focused on a national-security investigation; Trump said on the 16th that Huang's return certainly isn't a bad idea. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said on the 15th that the board should look outside the company for its next leader and asked the board and outside counsel to answer export-compliance questions within 10 days. Nvidia reports results after the US close on the 17th, presented by CFO and interim CEO Colette Kress, after guiding for revenue of about US$108 billion, plus or minus 2%, excluding any China data center compute revenue.

title.zh: 日本第三季GDP萎縮　四季來首見
title.en: Japan's Q3 GDP shrinks for first time in four quarters

body.zh: 日本 16 日公布第三季實質 GDP 初值季減 0.02%、年化減 0.1%，為四季來首度負成長，不如 QUICK 調查預估的年化成長 0.2%。占經濟約一半的民間消費季減 0.3%、連兩季下滑，進口增 2.5% 也拖累成長，資本支出則在 AI 伺服器與晶片設備帶動下增加 1.6%。市場普遍預期日本央行 12 月升息，部分分析師認為消費疲弱可能讓鴿派委員更趨謹慎。
body.en: Japan said on the 16th that preliminary real GDP fell 0.02% in the third quarter, or 0.1% annualised, its first contraction in four quarters and below the 0.2% annualised growth forecast in a QUICK survey. Private consumption, about half of the economy, fell 0.3% for a second straight quarterly decline and a 2.5% rise in imports also weighed, while capital spending rose 1.6% on AI servers and chip equipment. Markets widely expect a Bank of Japan rate hike in December, though some analysts said weak consumption could make dovish board members more cautious.

title.zh: 中國10月零售僅增0.4%　三大指標遜預期
title.en: China's October retail sales up just 0.4%; data miss forecasts

body.zh: 中國 16 日公布 10 月經濟數據，社會消費品零售總額年增 0.4%，低於市場預期的 0.8% 與 9 月的 1.1%；規模以上工業增加值年增 4.8%，不如預期的 5.3%。1 至 10 月固定資產投資年減 8.1%，跌幅較 1 至 9 月的 7.2% 擴大；城鎮調查失業率則由 5.2% 降至 5.1%。
body.en: China's October data released on the 16th showed retail sales up 0.4% from a year earlier, short of the 0.8% expected and September's 1.1%, while industrial output grew 4.8% against a 5.3% forecast. Fixed-asset investment for January to October fell 8.1%, a deeper decline than the 7.2% drop through September, while the surveyed urban unemployment rate eased to 5.1% from 5.2%.

title.zh: 新台幣貶4.8分收32.886　外資匯出趨緩
title.en: NT dollar slips to 32.886 as foreign outflows ease

body.zh: 台股 16 日重挫之際，新台幣兌美元收 32.886 元、貶值 4.8 分，盤中一度貶至 32.969 元，台北與元大外匯經紀公司合計成交 23.32 億美元。中央社指出，外資當日賣超台股 701.89 億元，但匯出力道趨緩，使新台幣貶幅收斂在 5 分以內。
body.en: As Taiwan stocks plunged on the 16th, the New Taiwan dollar closed at 32.886 per US dollar, down 4.8 cents, after weakening to as far as 32.969 during the session, with combined turnover of US$2.332 billion on the Taipei and Yuanta brokerages. CNA said foreign investors sold a net NT$70.189 billion of Taiwan shares that day, but slower outflows kept the currency's loss within 5 cents.

headline.zh: 台股重挫2,635點　史上第二大跌點
headline.en: TAIEX plunges 2,635 points, second-biggest point drop ever

body.zh: 加權指數 16 日以 43,512.42 點開出即為全日最高，隨後一路走低，終場下跌 2,635.04 點、收在最低點 41,040.08 點，跌幅 6.03%，為史上第二大收盤跌點，成交值 8,450.56 億元；上市 100 家上漲、967 家下跌，櫃買指數重挫 23.29 點（6.80%）收 319.12 點。權值股全面走弱，台積電跌 135 元收 2,215 元（5.74%），聯發科跌 325 元至 3,795 元，鴻海跌 22.5 元至 218.5 元，台達電跌停收 1,120 元。媒體歸納賣壓來自輝達執行長黃仁勳去職的後續效應、美股上週五費半重挫 3.43% 與美股期貨走低，以及市場對美國通膨與輝達新平台時程的疑慮；三大法人合計賣超 1,140.55 億元，投信終止連續 24 日買超，單日賣超創紀錄。
body.en: The TAIEX opened at 43,512.42 on the 16th, which proved the day's high, and slid all session to close at its low of 41,040.08, down 2,635.04 points or 6.03%, the second-largest closing point drop on record, on turnover of NT$845.06 billion; 100 listed stocks rose and 967 fell, while the TPEx index sank 23.29 points (6.80%) to 319.12. Heavyweights fell across the board: TSMC lost NT$135 to NT$2,215 (5.74%), MediaTek NT$325 to NT$3,795, Hon Hai NT$22.5 to NT$218.5, and Delta Electronics closed limit-down at NT$1,120. Media reports attributed the selling to fallout from Jensen Huang's exit as Nvidia CEO, Friday's 3.43% slide in the SOX and weaker US futures, and worries over US inflation and the timing of Nvidia's next platform; the three major institutional groups sold a net NT$114.055 billion, with investment trusts ending a 24-session buying streak with a record one-day net sale.

flows_note.zh: 三大法人同步賣超；投信終止連續 24 個交易日買超，單日賣超金額創紀錄。
flows_note.en: All three groups were net sellers; investment trusts ended a 24-session buying streak with a record one-day net sale.

headline.zh: 美股：費半重挫5.28%　四大指數全收黑
headline.en: US close, Nov 16: SOX sinks 5.28% as all major indexes fall

body.zh: 週一（16 日）美股全面走低，道瓊跌 739.38 點（1.41%）收 51,608.17 點，標普 500 跌 1.92%，那指跌 2.49% 收 24,509.76 點，費城半導體指數重挫 5.28%；台積電 ADR 跌 6.34%、收 373.45 美元。CNBC 報導輝達董事會不考慮讓黃仁勳回任後，輝達跌 4.12%，商務部同日宣布限制中國企業透過海外資料中心取得先進 AI 晶片，超微跌 5.58%、應用材料跌 5.47%，記憶體股美光跌 7.62%。市場同時等待輝達 17 日盤後財報，摩根大通旗下 Chase 發生系統中斷也拖累銀行股。
body.en: US stocks fell across the board on Monday, November 16: the Dow lost 739.38 points (1.41%) to 51,608.17, the S&P 500 fell 1.92%, the Nasdaq dropped 2.49% to 24,509.76 and the SOX tumbled 5.28%; the TSMC ADR slid 6.34% to US$373.45. Nvidia fell 4.12% after CNBC reported its board is not considering Jensen Huang's return, and the Commerce Department announced curbs on Chinese firms reaching advanced AI chips through overseas data centers, with AMD down 5.58%, Applied Materials 5.47% and memory maker Micron 7.62%. Investors also awaited Nvidia's results after the close on the 17th, and a system outage at JPMorgan's Chase weighed on bank shares.
